notices.title: Greg Miller Talks Kinda Funny's Future, Xbox & Sony's Woes and Finding Wisdom Through an Uber Driver
notices.contentSnippet: This week on Pause for Thought, Kinda Funny co-founder Greg Miller joins Naomi for a chat about the gaming industry. He runs us through some of his fave games from this year, what he thinks of the state of console gaming as well as what's up next for his brand. He also gives us insight into an amazing interaction he had with a random Uber driver.
